thread:
elena: Hey team 12yo had a sick visit with our kid's pediatrician and they said my card wasn't in their system. I had the insurer app but they still made me pay $60. I grabbed a receipt but it's not itemized. What should I do?

sam (People Ops): Sorry that happened, @elena. First: ask the clinic billing to produce an itemized statement (service date, CPT/description, provider name, tax ID or NPI). If they refuse, get a signed receipt and note the staff name you spoke to.

elena: Clinic said they're "transitioning EHRs" so they can't pull CPTs easily. They gave a short receipt with date and total only.

broker-jon: Two parallel moves: 1) submit an out-of-pocket claim now with what you have and the digital ID; 2) request the clinic re-bill once they can verify insurance. If re-billed, insurer should reprocess and refund you the difference (or adjust your member responsibility).

benefits-bot: Digital ID link for member 444777888: https://insurer.example/ids/444777888.pdf :card_file_box: 

sam (People Ops): Quick claim email template you can copy: 

To: claims@insurer.example
Subject: Member claim submission  pediatric urgent visit 2026-08-21  Member ID 444777888
Body: Please find attached the receipt for an urgent pediatric visit on 2026-08-21 for patient A.K. Member ID: 444777888, Group: RW-00011. Provider: Oak Ridge Pediatrics. Attachments: receipt.pdf, digital_id.pdf. Please advise processing timeline and next steps.

elena: Sent the claim and cc'd benefits@redwood.com. If insurer processes as out-of-network, can we appeal?

broker-jon: Yes. If provider is in-network but billed incorrectly, we'll file a provider directory dispute and request reprocessing. If truly out-of-network, we'll review the EOB and help with an appeal if needed. Typical insurer ack ~5-10 business days; EOB ~2-4 weeks.

elena: Also, how can I get a paper card? Some clinics insist.

sam (People Ops): Insurer portal > Account > Request Card will mail one. If you need it faster, reply here and I can flag an expedited request through our broker channel.

elena: Please flag expedited 1 that would help. Thanks for the quick responses.
